orders: Gravewalker, you are the thirteenth into this valley. Twelve went before you. Three weeks of silence.
Get the relay up. Hold Threshold. Bring ours home.
Extraction: Heron, night twenty. The lake is not safe to land on before then.
Return of issued equipment is expected. Return of personnel is encouraged.

lines: Relay's up. There's a spare board in the mast locker. Pull it, wire it the way I tell you, and it'll play the tone back at itself. Won't stop it. Will make a hole in it big enough for one man.
Threshold was a lockdown, nothing more. Wall up, look around, report. They had four quiet days.
Relay's up. This is Ridgeline. We lost FOB Threshold three weeks ago. All twelve. Good to hear anything. Hold where you are.

counters: Shambler · Save your ammo: the knife does the job.
Feral · Too quick for grenades. Let it close and use the shotgun.
Leaper · Shoot it before it lands. Don't try to knife it.
Military · Vests stop bullets. They move together: throw a grenade.
Drowned · Too wet to burn. The shotgun tears it apart.
Spider · Its shell turns bullets. Burn it off the wall.
Spitter · Shoot it while it creeps in. Don't get close.
Brute · Plates stop bullets. Blow it up or burn it.
Guardian · It lives in the dark. Fire drives it back.
